name: NW-53 Kalyan-Thane-Mumbai Financial Assessment (ROI / Budget Mapping)
authority: marine-intelligence-task internal analysis -- not an official government assessment

provenance.added_by: Shravani - BHIV Bharat Mala MMR extension
provenance.method: manual entry from cited public source

known_unknowns: RATE_CONFIG values are all None -- formula engine is ready but no real cost data has been sourced yet.
ROI cannot be computed without both cost data and cargo/traffic volume + revenue/savings projections (the latter depends on Scenario Simulation).
Only 2 of ~9 known NW-53 jetties currently in the data layer, so any future budget scheme will be partial until Kaushlendra's remaining jetties are added.
No official IWAI/MMRDA/state government cost benchmarks referenced yet -- pending confirmation from Akash Sir on data source access.

land_development_cost.note: Requires real per-hectare land acquisition and development rates for the MMR corridor (Thane/Bhiwandi/Kalyan land records or MMRDA benchmarks).

water_channel_development_cost.note: Requires real dredging and channel-construction cost benchmarks for NW-53 (IWAI cost norms or comparable inland waterway projects).

port_infra_setup_cost.note: Requires real port/jetty infrastructure capex benchmarks (berth construction, terminal equipment, land-side connectivity).

logistics_cost.note: Requires real logistics and transport cost data (per-tonne-km road vs. waterway cost comparison for the MMR corridor) and cargo volume from Scenario Simulation.
logistics_cost.methodology: cost = logistics_cost_per_tonne_km_inr * projected_annual_cargo_tonnes (per year; distance factor TBD once route length is fixed)

roi_assessment.note: ROI cannot be derived until all four cost components above are COMPUTED with real figures, along with projected revenue/savings from the Scenario Simulation module.
depends_on: scenario_simulation traffic/cargo volume and revenue/savings projections
